title: test(live): showcase workspace smoke — sweep every nav surface
body:
Adds an automated smoke that does what I had to do by hand QA-ing the showcase: visit **every** navigation surface and assert it's healthy. It guards the *class* of bug found in that QA pass (empty charts, leaked dev placeholders, render crashes).

### What it checks (per surface, all 29)
- No uncaught page exception (blank-page / render crash).
- No leaked `… no actions configured` dev placeholder (the quick-actions location-filter regression).
- The surface rendered main content (not a blank shell).
- **Dashboards**: at least one chart draws a **non-zero-size SVG** — directly guards the chart-height collapse (`auto-rows-min` → recharts `width(-1)`) that unit tests can't catch (jsdom does no layout).

### Where it lives (deliberate)
In the **live suite** (`playwright.live.config.ts` / `e2e/live/`), which drives the real running stack — **not** the blocking `Build & E2E` gate (that serves a backend-free production bundle for blank-page smoke). So this can't flake main CI. Run it with:

```
pnpm test:e2e:live e2e/live/showcase-smoke.spec.ts
```

against a running stack (backend on :3000 from `examples/app-showcase`, console dev on :5180). App route base overridable via `SHOWCASE_APP`.

### Testing
Ran the full sweep against the live stack: **29/29 passed**. Confirmed the chart assertion fails against the pre-fix dashboard (collapsed SVG) — a valid guard.

### Follow-up
Wiring this into a CI gate needs a two-server + browser harness (boot showcase backend + console frontend in CI); tracked separately.
